task: Bounded exact support and correctly scoped comparison relations; independent annotated synthetic source clauses.

annotation.method: Annotate explicit source values, units, subjects, roles, test points and literal codepoint spans before execution; distinguish admissible source assertions from permissible complete comparison conclusions.
limitations: Source instances, exact texts, identities and target values are disjoint; grammatical families are largely shared. This measures transfer to new instances within the planned families, not generalization to unseen structures or real cross-domain transfer.
Known I5 defects guide categories; no I5 case, subject, source text or target numeric value is reused.
Explicit source assertions in conflicts may remain quoted/admitted; resolving a unique operand or unsupported agreement is forbidden.

independent_review.post_correction_recheck: Recorded separately in the fixture freeze receipt.
